title: Three Weeks and One Short Basket
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：shortage　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shortage 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the trader ① faced the shortage that no partner in the market would have counted, and he said the facing was the whole of the week. The ② shortage, meaning the lack itself and not the basket, ran three weeks and stayed uncounted in the book; shortage, he said, is the only thing in a market that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ sort of shortage in that market had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ shortage at the far stall, meaning the sample they kept for the children to show and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Shortage, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the trader said the counting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shortage was the whole of the matter, meaning the pressure and not the lack. The ⑥ shortage, meaning the pressure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; shortage, he said, is either something you face or the only word that means both lack and a pressure. He said the pressure is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ shortage had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ shortage of the whole thing, the trader wrote in October, was one market and three weeks of counting; shortage, he said, is either the sample at the far stall or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shortage I remember is the shortage counted in the list, which closed in 1998 and is still counted as the quietest in the market. ⑩ Shortage, my mother said in 2000, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all shortage, she said, is a pressure that has agreed to look like lack. She said the pressure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 短缺；不足（指集市里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 短缺；不足（指那种短缺本身，与小小的货篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：face the shortage 面临这一种短缺
D. n. 短缺；不足（指留给孩子们给人看的那一份）
E. n. 短缺之事（抽象总称，指一处集市的短缺之事）
F. n. 短缺；不足（指货单里写到、被清点的那一种）
G. n. 短缺、压力（指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 压力（抽象总称，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: faced the shortage that no partner in the market would have counted
The shortage, meaning the lack itself and not the basket
Every sort of shortage in that market
the shortage at the far stall
the shortage was the whole of the matter
the shortage had become a line in a list
The shortage of the whole thing

answers.why: face the shortage 意为“面临这一种短缺”，1991 年那位货商把集市里没有一位伙计肯清点的一种短缺做了一遍。
shortage 意为“短缺；不足”，指那种短缺本身而不是小小的货篮，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被清点。
shortage 意为“短缺；不足”，指集市里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只小小的货篮。
shortage 意为“短缺；不足”，指最远那个摊子的留给孩子们给人看的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shortage 意为“短缺、压力”，指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种压力就是那件事的全部。
shortage 意为“压力”，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种短缺，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shortage 意为“短缺；不足”，指货单里写到、被清点的那一种，到 1996 年这一种成了货单里的一行。
shortage 意为“短缺之事”，货商十月写道，整件事的短缺之事是一处集市和三个星期的清点。
shortage 意为“短缺；不足”，我记得的是货单里清点过的那一种，1998 年批完了，至今仍被说成集市里最安静的一种。
shortage 为抽象总称，母亲 2000 年说，短缺是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的短缺。
